absorbed_controls.btc_log_return: Common across assets on each date and therefore exactly absorbed by date fixed effects; never fit it as an independently identified coefficient.

inference: Null-imposed wild-cluster t bootstrap with Rademacher asset weights, enumerating all 32 assignments for five assets, with CR1 cluster covariance. Exact enumeration is not a finite-sample validity guarantee, particularly with only two stake-positive assets.
uncertainty: No calibrated confidence interval or causal interpretation. Report coefficient, effect per 1-percentage-point change in stake share, cluster standard error, 32-sign bootstrap p and BH q. Two-sided p-value grid is at least 2/32 = 0.0625 in nondegenerate cases.
guardrails: Do not run on partial ETH data or replace it with BNB-only inference.
Do not select outcomes, windows, controls or quote sources based on results.
Turnover is not executable market liquidity; trading volume, prices and staking can respond jointly to other forces.
ETH effective balance measures consensus weight; BNB pool totals use a different chain-specific measurement. Neither measures all inaccessible supply, and liquid staking can leave exposure tradeable.
next_required: Configure ETH_BEACON_ARCHIVE_API_URL locally and collect exact active effective balance for every study date. Historical validator access is required; do not paste credentials into research files.
